plugins.description: Publish your Claude Code site. Claude runs `npx -y dropthehassle@latest deploy` and your site is live on a free HTTPS link, no account needed. Want your own .com? Claude finds a name and hands you a €19/$19 payment link. You pay, and the site goes live on it with no DNS. A real mailbox on it is optional. Claude never pays.
